title: Hikers photograph diamond-shaped craft, men in black follow

tellings.quote: two witnesses were out hiking. They then saw a large diamondshaped craft hovering.

plain: Two people out hiking are said to have seen a large, diamond-shaped craft hovering, and to have photographed it, after which so-called men in black, mysterious visitors said to call on UFO witnesses, came after them. A UFO researcher named James Fox passes this on from what he was told, without giving a time or place. If true, it would mean the sighting drew attention from someone who wanted it kept quiet.
